title: AgentProviderUnavailableResult.v1
description: Returned (NOT raised) when the selected harness/runtime is a CANDIDATE with no runtime/credential in this repo (OpenClaw/Hermes-style runtimes are catalog entries only — never imported or executed here), or is unknown. Graceful degradation: the system stays green and falls back to the deterministic local emulator. consumable is pinned const false (nothing here is a usable result) and serves_truth is pinned const false (it is not truth). runtime_ref is an env://<NAME> reference (never a value) so the caller can SEE which runtime/credential WOULD be needed.

provider_id.description: id of the harness/runtime provider that was unavailable

runtime_ref.description: env://<NAME> reference to the runtime/credential that WOULD be required — NEVER a value; null if none applies

consumable.description: ALWAYS false — an unavailable result carries no usable output

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — an unavailable result is not truth
